title: A tier that sells below cost shows the warning with the lowest cost
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, with two ranges, $0.00 to $100.00 and from $100.01: Default on + $ 10 in both ranges, tier A on % Off 20 in both ranges.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Point at the warning icon beside tier A's first-range value.
  4. Point at the warning icon beside tier A's last-range value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • A warning icon shows to the right of tier A's value in both ranges.
  • Default's values (Cost + $10) have no warning icon.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads tier A's name followed by "sells a $40.03 part below cost." ($40.03 + $10.00 = $50.03, 20% off = $40.024, rounded to $40.02, below $40.03).
  • At $40.02 the price is $40.02 ($50.02 × 0.80 = $40.016, rounded to $40.02), equal to the cost, so $40.03 is the lowest.

Step 4:

  • A tooltip reads tier A's name followed by "sells a $100.01 part below cost." ($100.01 + $10.00 = $110.01, 20% off = $88.008, rounded to $88.01, below $100.01).
